title: Cutting a Fence
statementMd:
Vasya the carpenter has an estate that is separated from the wood by a fence. The fence consists of $*n*$ planks put in a line. The fence is not closed in a circle. The planks are numbered from left to right from 1 to $*n*$, the $*i*$-th plank is of height $*a*_{*i*}$. All planks have the same width, the lower edge of each plank is located at the ground level.

Recently a local newspaper "Malevich and Life" wrote that the most fashionable way to decorate a fence in the summer is to draw a fuchsia-colored rectangle on it, the lower side of the rectangle must be located at the lower edge of the fence.

Vasya is delighted with this idea! He immediately bought some fuchsia-colored paint and began to decide what kind of the rectangle he should paint. Vasya is sure that the rectangle should cover $*k*$ consecutive planks. In other words, he will paint planks number $*x*$, $*x* + 1$, $...$, $*x* + *k* - 1$ for some $*x*$ $(1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n* - *k* + 1)$. He wants to paint the rectangle of maximal area, so the rectangle height equals $*min* *a*_{*i*}$ for $*x* ≤ *i* ≤ *x* + *k* - 1$, $*x*$ is the number of the first colored plank.

Vasya has already made up his mind that the rectangle width can be equal to one of numbers of the sequence $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$. For each $*k*_{*i*}$ he wants to know the expected height of the painted rectangle, provided that he selects $*x*$ for such fence uniformly among all $*n* - *k*_{*i*} + 1$ possible values. Help him to find the expected heights.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6})$ — the number of planks in the fence. The second line contains a sequence of integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the height of the $*i*$-th plank of the fence.

The third line contains an integer $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{6})$ and the next line contains $*m*$ space-separated integers $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$ $(1 ≤ *k*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ where $*k*_{*i*}$ is the width of the desired fuchsia-colored rectangle in planks.

## Output

Print $*m*$ whitespace-separated real numbers, the $*i*$-th number equals the expected value of the rectangle height, if its width in planks equals $*k*_{*i*}$. The value will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 9}$.

## Note

Let's consider the first sample test.

- There are three possible positions of the fence for $*k*_{1} = 1$. For the first position $(*x* = 1)$ the height is 3, for the second one $(*x* = 2)$ the height is 2, for the third one $(*x* = 3)$ the height is 1. As the fence position is chosen uniformly, the expected height of the fence equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0ed28200fa09ec6d42acd5ca3000c84f76b97429.png);
- There are two possible positions of the fence for $*k*_{2} = 2$. For the first position $(*x* = 1)$ the height is 2, for the second one $(*x* = 2)$ the height is 1. The expected height of the fence equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3b5954017d5a606755151a3722724884260d7e16.png);
- There is the only possible position of the fence for $*k*_{3} = 3$. The expected height of the fence equals 1.
statementZhMd:
木匠 Vasya 有一处庄园，庄园与树林之间由一道栅栏隔开。栅栏由排成一列的 $*n*$ 块木板组成。栅栏不是围成一圈的。木板从左到右编号为 1 到 $*n*$，第 $*i*$ 块木板的高度为 $*a*_{*i*}$。所有木板的宽度都相同，并且每块木板的下边缘都位于地面高度。

最近，当地报纸《马列维奇与生活》报道说，夏季装饰栅栏最时髦的方式是在上面画一个紫红色矩形，且矩形的下边必须位于栅栏的下边缘。

Vasya 对这个主意非常满意！他立刻买了一些紫红色油漆，并开始决定要画一个怎样的矩形。Vasya 确定矩形应该覆盖连续的 $*k*$ 块木板。换句话说，对于某个 $*x*$ $(1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n* - *k* + 1)$，他将给编号为 $*x*$、$*x* + 1$、$...$、$*x* + *k* - 1$ 的木板涂色。为了使矩形面积最大，矩形的高度应等于 $*min* *a*_{*i*}$，其中 $*x*$ ≤ $*i*$ ≤ $*x* + *k* - 1$，$*x*$ 是第一块被涂色木板的编号。

Vasya 已经决定，矩形的宽度可以是序列 $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$ 中的某一个数。对于每个 $*k*_{*i*}$，他想知道：如果在所有 $*n* - *k*_{*i*} + 1$ 个可能的 $*x*$ 中等概率地选择一个，所画矩形的期望高度是多少。请帮助他求出这些期望高度。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6})$，表示栅栏中的木板数量。第二行包含一个整数序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$)，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示栅栏中第 $*i*$ 块木板的高度。

第三行包含一个整数 $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{6})$，下一行包含 $*m*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$ $(1 ≤ *k*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$，其中 $*k*_{*i*}$ 表示所需紫红色矩形的木板宽度。

## 输出格式

输出 $*m*$ 个以空格分隔的实数，第 $*i*$ 个数等于矩形木板宽度为 $*k*_{*i*}$ 时矩形高度的期望值。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则认为答案正确。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。

- 当 $*k*_{1} = 1$ 时，栅栏有三种可能的位置。对于第一个位置（$*x* = 1$），高度为 3；对于第二个位置（$*x* = 2$），高度为 2；对于第三个位置（$*x* = 3$），高度为 1。由于栅栏位置是等概率选择的，栅栏高度的期望值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0ed28200fa09ec6d42acd5ca3000c84f76b97429.png)；
- 当 $*k*_{2} = 2$ 时，栅栏有两种可能的位置。对于第一个位置（$*x* = 1$），高度为 2；对于第二个位置（$*x* = 2$），高度为 1。栅栏高度的期望值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3b5954017d5a606755151a3722724884260d7e16.png)；
- 当 $*k*_{3} = 3$ 时，只有一种可能的位置。栅栏高度的期望值为 1。
